description.Name: This name is used as an identifier for the template
description.Display: This is the name that will be displayed to users for example during server creation
description.Type: This is used to group different templates and to decide what icon to display for it on the server list
description.Variables: Variables will be shown to users as settings on a server, they are useful for example to let the user define what version to use or to define some settings like the port to use
description.Install: Here you define what steps will be run when a user hits the install button of a server created from this template
description.Command: This is the command that will be executed to start the server
description.StopCommand: Write a command to the servers console when a users hits the srvers stop button
description.StopSignal: Send a signal to the server when a users hits the srvers stop button, this can for example be used to emulate hitting CTRL+C
description.PreRunHook: Here you can define some steps to run every time just before the server starts
description.PostRunHook: Here you can define some steps to run every time after the server stops
